minutes.headline: School Committee took no budget action; it heard a gym-fee complaint, passed the calendar policy reading waiver and accepted a donation.
minutes.summary: The meeting opened with a parent's public comment about travel basketball games at Turkey Hill and practice fees. The committee approved minutes, waived the second reading of the school calendar policy, accepted a memorial fund donation for trip scholarships, and heard the superintendent's award presentation and subcommittee reports. It then went into executive session on litigation strategy without returning to public session.

public_comment.topic: A parent of travel basketball (grades 4-8) objected that home games are at Turkey Hill gym while varsity gets the high school gym, and asked for some games in the high school gym or reduced fees.
Announcement of the class of 2019 clothing fundraiser benefiting the Epilepsy Foundation, collection through December 5.

votes.motion: Approve regular session minutes of October 4 and 18 with revision
Waive the second reading of policy 5105.04, the school calendar
Accept the $2,500 donation from the Connor B Lawrence Memorial Fund and allocate as the superintendent suggests
Adjourn to executive session under MGL c30A s21 to discuss litigation strategy, not returning to public session

budget_items.what_was_said: A parent said fees rose and asked that the fee be reduced if games are all away.
A parent referred to the new high school's cost in complaining about the Turkey Hill gym.

budget_items.topic: Memorial fund donation for trip scholarships
budget_items.what_was_said: Donation accepted, to be split between Turkey Hill and the middle school for nature's classroom and Washington DC trip scholarships.
The class earns a per-pound payment on collected clothing.
Scenarios on cost and sustaining the initiative will be shown in the budget presentation on the 16th.

decisions.decision: Public comment on the calendar policy will be collected through the next meeting on November 16, with a noon deadline, and brought back to the committee.
Administrators will report on the effects of last year's added positions and class size changes when they present next year's budget.

what_happened.line: The School Committee waived the second reading of the school calendar policy, and public comment on it will be collected until noon before the November 16 meeting.
The committee accepted a memorial fund donation for trip scholarships, to be split between Turkey Hill and the middle school as the superintendent suggested.
A parent of a travel basketball player objected to home games at the Turkey Hill gym and to practice fees, and asked for high school gym games or reduced fees.
Administrators are to report on the effects of last year's added positions and class size changes when they present next year's budget.
The committee went into executive session on litigation strategy at the end of the meeting and did not return to public session.

why_it_matters: Athletic and practice fees are paid by families, and the gym-use complaint may bring those fees and the scheduling of home games back to the committee.
The budget presentation on the 16th is expected to include costs and options for sustaining one-to-one Chromebooks, a recurring expense that will compete with other school spending.
watch_next: November 16 meeting: calendar policy comment closes at noon, and the budget presentation includes Chromebook cost scenarios.
The administrators' report on the effects of last year's added positions and class size changes, due with the budget presentation.
